content.title: Fix serialize deletes in cleanupE2ESeeds E2E seed straggler race
content.description: In packages/webapp/e2e/setup.ts cleanupE2ESeeds issues all DELETE calls concurrently. The agentrack backend performs unlocked read-modify-write on the file store so concurrent deletes can race and silently drop some (errors are swallowed in the inner catch). Result e2e-seed stragglers can survive a spec afterAll until the next run global-setup reset. Low severity no real-data leak but trivial to fix. Acceptance criteria replace the concurrent call with a sequential for-of-await loop over the seeds array preserve best-effort semantics with errors still swallowed keep E2E_SEED_TAG and the list-then-delete flow unchanged optionally update the docstring run npx playwright test --list to confirm specs still load. Context Accepted in review mqiax8g35i child of idea mqh5aew5am. Do NOT touch global-setup the cosmetic BACKEND_PORT sub-claim was verified stale.

content.content:
Done. Replaced the concurrent Promise.all DELETE in cleanupE2ESeeds (packages/webapp/e2e/setup.ts) with a sequential for...of await loop over the seeds array. Best-effort semantics preserved — per-delete try/catch still swallows already-deleted/404 errors, and the global-setup reset remains the authoritative wipe. E2E_SEED_TAG and the list-then-delete flow are unchanged. Updated the explanatory comment to document why serialization is required (unlocked read-modify-write on the backend file store).

Verification:
- `npx playwright test --list` → all 176 tests in 6 files load cleanly.
- `npx tsc --noEmit` → no errors in e2e/setup.ts (no new errors introduced).

No backend change. global-setup and README untouched as scoped. Full regression run (npx playwright test) delegated to webapp-validator — note port 5000 may be held by macOS AirPlay Receiver locally.

Verified complete. The worker (webapp-developer) delivered the fix and reported it in the previous comment but left status at `todo`. Audit: packages/webapp/e2e/setup.ts cleanupE2ESeeds() now uses a sequential for...of await loop (no Promise.all), per-delete try/catch still swallows already-deleted/404, E2E_SEED_TAG and list-then-delete flow unchanged, docstring explains the race rationale. Acceptance criteria met. Marking done.
